name: Huitongda Network Co., Ltd.
summary: Huitongda Network Co., Ltd., an industrial internet company, provides digital technologies and supply chain capabilities in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Commerce Business, Service Business, and Others segments. It engages in direct sales of merchandise in commerce business. The company also offers intelligent business and marketing subscription services, and collection of merchant solutions, as well as various other related services. Huitongda Network Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Nanjing, the People's Republic of China.
